mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment(order_id, order_type, pay_no, amount, pay_method, status, create_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{orderType}, #{payNo}, #{amount}, #{payMethod}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payment WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE payment SET pay_time = #{payTime} WHERE id = #{id}
